topic: Release of analytics features and data
summary_markdown:
The team finalized the release of several analytics features, including tooltips and category multiselect. Data for the Bus shelter category was confirmed as ready on analytics.allunite.com for client communication.

Multiple participants approved the release after confirming that no API changes were required. The final deployment included both tooltips and category multiselect functionality.
decisions: Tooltips and category multiselect features were released to analytics.allunite.com
Data for the Bus shelter category is ready for client communication
action_items: The email regarding Lithuania was sent to the client
